The economy strand's view of the endgame: you now sign in out of habit, the wallet funds the shop runs, and the rings and cells are on the shelf. The crossover complex is one convergence quest away from finished.

Look ahead: the Gate of Trials in the challenge zone will demand banked criticals and sustained 300 percent engineering; the exchange zone beyond it will happily take your surplus; and the final Master gates on every zone entrance — including this one.

Warm up the economy now. The trials bill in singularities, and singularities bill in steam.
